_notes: WHAT SHAPE EACH ENERGY CARD CUTS (docs/design/minigames.md #3).
Owner 2026-08-13: 'treat it as another card game, each new card drawn has
a shape on it. the shape corresponds to the energy type.' Patch the Ward
no longer offers a rack of patches at the start -- the player winds down
their own spool, one card at a time, and takes whatever cloth that card
cuts. Drawing more mends more and leaves less for the fight after.
Keyed by ENERGY CARD ID, so every card in data/energy_cards.json owes a
shape and Catalog.validate() says so if one is missing. Offsets are
[row, col] from the shape's top-left; they must be connected edge to edge
(a patch is one piece of cloth) and are normalised at load.
The humour is the CHARACTER of the cut and the worth is its SIZE:
ferocity  -- the rake: straight, and as long as the card is worth
guile     -- the crook: bent, awkward to place, covers more than it looks
shadow    -- the blot: compact, square, fills a corner
moonlight -- the odd stitch: small and strange, the one that finishes
